headline: Recommended holding youth vaping and tobacco item 3-0 after public testimony on addiction and vape rules.
summary: Speakers discussed youth vaping, tobacco rule changes, and ways to reduce youth access to vape products. The minutes of the June 8, 2026 meeting were approved. The youth tobacco, nicotine, and vaping item was recommended to be held on a 3 Yeas and 0 Nays roll call vote.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the June 8, 2026 meeting.
Recommended holding the item on youth exposure to tobacco, nicotine, and vaping products, 3 Yeas and 0 Nays.

decision_evidence.quote: Chairperson Councilor Rosen read the item and moved to adopt the item. Order adopted
Chairperson Councilor Rosen moved for a roll call vote to recommend the item be held. Recommend Hold on a roll call vote of 3 Yeas and 0 Nays

. Miscellaneous Item 3 
August 24, 2026 Page 2 of 6Public Health and Human Services Committee
Order of Councilor Gary Rosen, Councilor Morris A. Bergman, Councilor Tony 
Economou, Councilor John P. Fresolo, Councilor Khrystian E. King, Councilor Satya B . 
Mitra, Councilor Luis A. Ojeda, Councilor Jose A. Rivera, Councilor Kathleen M . 
Toomey and Mayor Joseph M. Petty - Request Standing Committee on Public Health and 
Human Services hold a meeting with representatives from the Board of Health, selected 
medical professionals, youth advocacy agencies and appropriate representatives from the 
Worcester Public Schools to discuss youth exposure and addiction to tobacco, nicotine 
and vaping, among others.
# 12v CC July 21, 2026
a.
August 24, 2026 Page 3 of 6Public Health and Human Services Committee
Chairperson Councilor Rosen read the item and discussed public concerns relative to the Board of 
Health’s modifications to tobacco business siting rules, increased risks of youth exposure and 
addiction to tobacco, nicotine and vaping products, current advertisement practices targeting 
youths used by companies selling such products and the needs to increase education and reduce 
access to such products for the youths.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen recognized the Board of Health Chairperson, who discussed 
regulations prohibiting selling smoking and vaping products to youth and the needs for 
community-wide response, including education and creation of an enforcement process.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen recognized the Board of Health member, who discussed the 
addictiveness of vaping and e -cigarettes and how they affect the lungs, including E -cigarette or 
Vaping Use -Associated Lung Injury (EVALI) and new regulations relative to sales of smoking and 
vaping products.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen recognized the Assistant Commissioner of Health and Human 
Services, who discussed the collaboration between the Board of Health and the Department of 
Health and Human Services related to tobacco sales and issues related youths using vapes.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen recognized Councilor Toomey, who discussed concerns related to 
increase of THC in vapes and keeping parents informed.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen recognized Speaker #1, who discussed misinformation concerning 
vapes, how tobacco companies are targeting youths with flavored products, the prevalence of 
vaping among middle school and high school students and the programs by Worcester 
Anti-Vaping Task Force to teach youths how to manage stress and anxiety.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen brought forth the following Chairman’s Order: Request City 
Manager provide City Council with a report concerning the amount of money the city receives 
from sales and /or settlements associated with tobacco, vapes and nicotine products, as well as how 
much of those monies are spent on tobacco cessation and prevention purposes.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen recognized Speaker #2, who discussed health issues related to 
vaping and results from community survey relative to youth vaping, 
Chairperson Councilor Rosen recognized the Interim Director of Public Health, who discussed 
results from the Youth Health Survey conducted by the Division of Public Health.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen recognized the Director of Youth Opportunities, who discussed the 
work done by the Division of Youth Opportunities to address vaping addiction in youths.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen recognized the Worcester Medical Director, who discussed 
modifications to the tobacco regulations done by the Board of Health, solutions to address issues 
related to youths vaping and resources to help youths quit vaping.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen recognized the WPS Administrative Director of Student Support 
and Engagement, who discussed WPS strategies to address youth vaping through prevention and 
education.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen recognized the following speakers:

Chairperson Councilor Rosen recognized Councilor Toomey, who discussed broader issues related 
to mental health causing youths to begin vaping, the importance of peer mentorship, school and 
parent engagement and public education, the usage of social media to educate the public about 
vaping.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen recognized Speaker #1, who discussed the importance of funding 
community organizations to expand prevention programs.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen recognized the Board of Health member, who discussed the 
feasibility of having in -school resources to educate the school nurses and providing students with 
referrals to addiction therapy.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen recognized Councilor Toomey, who discussed recovery schools for 
students with addictions.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen recognized Councilor King, who discussed the needs for city -wide 
public service education campaign, the importance of addressing root causes of youth vaping 
related to mental health issues and the feasibility related to installation of vaping -detection 
technology in WPS and educational efforts related to vaping in elementary schools with the 
Worcester Public Schools Administrative Director of Student Support and Engagement.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen brought forth the following two (2) Chairman’s Orders: 1) Request 
City Clerk provide the minutes and recording of the Standing Committee on Public Health and 
Human Services meeting on August 24, 2026 to the Worcester Public Schools administration; and 
2) Request City Manager create a public service campaign related to preventing the city’s youth 
from using tobacco, nicotine and vaping products.
Chairperson Councilor Rosen moved for a roll call vote to recommend the item be held.
Recommend Hold on a roll call vote of 3 Yeas and 0 Nays
